snippet.title: Reoxia - Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Reoxia is a single-player, story-driven first-person shooter. You are an astronaut who has returned to Earth after a catastrophe caused by an outbreak of an unknown disease. You are the only one uninfected. You must fight bloodthirsty infected, mutants, and armed humans who start hunting for you.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/4545150/Reoxia

Music by: ExpansionAudio - info[at]expansionaudio.com
